t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The different colour gnomes will send you to 2 different forests. Your aim is to go to the forest with the most mushrooms but the amount of mushrooms can change constantly.

vb_textbox.text: Hello, best of luck with the game ahead.Key thing to note: there are two different forests - a darker, gloomy one and a brighter green-tree one. In each round you will be presented with two gnomes and each one will take you to a different forest. The forests will give you points and your aim is to pick the one that gives you the most mushrooms. The amount of mushrooms keeps changing so keep your eye out for any patterns.The gnome appear in fixed pairs: orange + brown; green + pink; red + yellow; blue + purple. The orange, green, red and blue gnomes take you to the brighter forest and the others take you to the gloomy forest. Nothing else about the gnomes matter, just the colours. Best of luck!
